subject: Render DELTA9 plan: guards + inert fallbacks/encoders
body:
Read C4/HEAD, audit C4 blockers, current board. Render-owned plan, no shared ABI change:
1. Restore nord2_render_pass duplicate-colour-texture guard (explicit inert pass).
2. Extend the backboardd+TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES helper to descriptor/non-Tegu-function failures and missing COMPOSITOR/GENERIC_JOB capability paths; allocation failure may remain nil. Trace via existing bounded TEGU_INERT_PIPELINE.
3. In render_encoder, committed/currently-encoding command returns a nonnil inert encoder only in backboardd when the flag is compiled in; nil elsewhere; bounded TEGU_RENDER_INERT_ENCODER trace.
Host tests both flag states/backboardd/non-backboardd. No compute/n2r/bridge edits; no native/phone/publish/commit. FREEZE respected.
